story_zh: 李明是三年级的聪明学生。他每天在图书馆复习数学和历史。他用词典查中文句子，在笔记本上写作业。他认为认真可以提高水平。校长看到他的好成绩，认为他年轻又努力。李明想留学，所以更用功学习。
story_pinyin: Lǐ Míng shì sān niánjí de cōngmíng xuéshēng. Tā měitiān zài túshūguǎn fùxí shùxué hé lìshǐ. Tā yòng cídiǎn chá zhōngwén jùzi, zài bǐjìběn shàng xiě zuòyè. Tā rènwéi rènzhēn kěyǐ tígāo shuǐpíng. Xiàozhǎng kàndào tā de hǎo chéngjì, rènwéi tā niánqīng yòu nǔlì. Lǐ Míng xiǎng liúxué, suǒyǐ gèng yònggōng xuéxí.
story_en: Li Ming is a clever third-grade student. He reviews mathematics and history in the library every day. He uses a dictionary to look up Chinese sentences and writes homework in his notebook. He thinks being serious can improve his level. The principal sees his good grades and thinks he is young and hard-working. Li Ming wants to study abroad, so he studies even harder.
